/Look v3: small refinements

Proposed · 12 Nov 2026

Same X2F.
A little more light.

Small refinements taken from the qualities you liked in the wallet recording: a lit background, tiles that float, soft shadows, glossy icons, pill buttons and springy motion. Every screen keeps its layout, content order and flow. Orange stays the one action colour and teal stays escrow.

What we took

Light from the top, tiles with gaps and a lighter top edge, soft drop shadows, a halo behind the one hero, glossy tokens, pills, a floating dock, spring physics.

What we left behind

Their violet, their emblem and hexagon coin shapes, their icons. Tokens here are rounded squares in our own hues, drawn from our tokens.

The approved intro (logo and letter animation unchanged), now on the lit ground.

01

The refinements

Ordered by impact for effort, so the cheap, high-impact ones can ship first. Each card shows a crop of today's board next to the same crop refined. Items 15 and 16 are optional.

02

Four screens: Today vs Refined

Both phones scroll. Same content, same order. Words trimmed only where an "i" button or a card lower down already says it. All new words are COPY-UNSIGNED.

03

Motion lab

Tap things in the phone, or use the buttons. Springs are sampled into CSS linear() easings, the same way as the intro's letters. With Reduced motion on, everything becomes a short crossfade.

04

Type: where the new sans goes

The owner asked to borrow the reference's clean sans for certain places only. Recommended: Inter (open licence, self-hostable, optical sizes) on titles, names, buttons and big prices. Atkinson Hyperlegible stays for body and help text. Mono stays for codes, addresses and exact XMR. Use the Type toggle at the top to compare every screen.

05

Light shadowing: three levels

Every level is a faint lighter top edge plus a soft drop. Values switch with the theme. Exact values are in look-v3.md.

Everything on this page is PROPOSED and waits for the owner's OK. The boards are not changed. New words are COPY-UNSIGNED.

Spec: design-brief/docs/design-12nov/look-v3.md. Today's crops are rendered from the canvas boards BuyMain, BuyOffers, TradeFund and Settings (12 Nov), plus the intro prototype's tab bar.
